creator: digital_umuganda
transcription: Nzvimbo iri mudhorobheni inoratidza kuti ringori besanwa vanhu vachienda muzvitoro zvakasiyana siyana. Tinoonawo motikari dzakafuratira dzinosanganisira imwe tsvuku nekarori kari kuenda mberi kwedhorobheni iri. Pane robhoti rinova ravadzvuku ndosaka dzimwe motikari dzakamira.

creator: digital_umuganda

creator: digital_umuganda

creator: digital_umuganda

creator: digital_umuganda

creator: digital_umuganda

creator: digital_umuganda

creator: digital_umuganda

creator: digital_umuganda

creator: digital_umuganda
transcription: Nzvimbo ine bundo zhinji rakasvibira rinoratidza kuti rine mupfudze nemwando wakakwana. Nechekumberi kwacho tirikuona mhuka dzakasimudza musoro dzakati kwangwa zheve dzakatarisa divi rimwe. Kumberi kwacho tikuona miti mukuru ine matavi akapindana pindana.

creator: digital_umuganda

creator: digital_umuganda

creator: digital_umuganda

transcription: Manwiwa akanaka akarongwa akaita murwi, akamirira kutengeswa. Kumashure kune zvivakwa zvitoro, paine munhu mumwechete ane hembe yeruvara rwemvura.

creator: digital_umuganda
transcription: Mugwagwa wakaiswa tara une ruvara rwutema neruvara rwakachenerukira. Mugwagwa uyu une dzimotikari imwe ine ruvara rwuchena imwe ine ruvara  rwebhuruu. Nechemurutivi mune ruzhowa rwakavakwa rwune ruvara  rwakachenurukira.

creator: digital_umuganda
transcription: Maheji akadyarwa pamadziro. Aya maruva anoshongedza mhemberekedzo dzemadziro kana kuti dzinodyarwa dzakati kwati kuri kuda kushongedzwa. Iyi heji yakatumbuka zvitsvuku.

creator: digital_umuganda
transcription: Chidziro chakakomberedzwa nemaruva akanaka zvikuru.  Pane mamwe matsvuku poita mamwe  aneruva rwe girinhi ari kunze kwe chidziro.   Uyewo akadyarwa akatevedza chidziro ichi . Pouyawo zvekare rimwe ruva ririkubuda kubva mukati mechidziro rakamira pamusoro rine ruvara rwe girinhi.

creator: digital_umuganda
transcription: Masimbi matsvuku. Varume vaviri vakamira pamasimbi matsvuku. Kuruboshwe kune mudhuri wakavakwa nemarata emazen'e.

creator: digital_umuganda
transcription: Nzvimbo huru yakapfumba inoratidza kuti inofambwa vazhinji. Nechekumberi kwacho kune bhazi reyero rakamira rekwaInter Africa. Kumashure kwe bhazi iri kune mufananidzo wendenge dzinoratidza kuti dzakavakirwapo.

creator: digital_umuganda
transcription: Chitoro chine shangu dzevamunhukadzi dzirikutengeswa, dzine makara akasiyana , dzine mabhadhi pamusoro padzo ayo anobata tsoka kana dzichinge dzapfekwa. mune zvakare mabhureyidzi arimo.
